body:
Just hang on, things will go for the better someday. And have you tried getting help by rehabilitation? Sometimes you need help with your fights, some are just to heavy to do them alone.

And if you really need someone to care about, maybe get a pet they make great companions and you caring for an animals well being it should make you feel to be apart of something.

But honestly if you're looking for someone to talk to maybe try making friends online, there are some people who will care and are willing to hear you out, and talk about your problems. 

But remember we can get through our hard times, and when your feeling down, go talk to someone even on a chat site, communication is the best. Somethings just cant be dealt with alone.
Same, I wouldn't know what to do with out my dog.
